item.title: SPENCER MACKENZIE // EMPTY CHAIRS // ALBUM REVIEW
item.description: 9In a recent interview, I discovered that Spencer Mackenzie picked up his first guitar at age 5! Now that really is an early start. As he studied at university, his tutor suggested he listen to Stevie Ray Vaughan. S.R.V. was an unknown artist to the young Mackenzie, but his dad pointed him in the right direction. item.description: BUNT. TEAMS UP WITH THE TEMPER TRAP ON “WHAT IF YOU FLY (SWEET DISPOSITION)” OUT NOW – LISTEN HERE + ANNOUNCES TAYLOR SWIFT REMIX OF “OPALITE” Stutter house and “in the round” touring pioneer, BUNT., returns with his heartfelt spin on the beloved global phenom “Sweet Disposition” by Australian rockers The Temper Trap, “What If You Fly (Sweet Disposition),” out now via Arista Records. item.description: Due to phenomenal demand, Little Angels have added three new dates to their highly anticipated return to the stage.
